card.title: How To Fix an iPhone SE 2020 That Randomly Restarts

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone SE 2020 That Randomly Restarts

claims.statement: iPhone SE 2020 Missing sensors TG0B/TG0V = battery path: check MOSFETs Q3200/Q3201 and diode-check I2C3_SMC_TO_GG_SCL_CONN / I2C3_SMC_BI_GG_SDA_CONN.
Mic1 can be a bad charging port flex (iPhone 8 port flexes fitted to SE 2020 often cause restarts) or the common board defect where I2C1_AP_SDA / I2C1_AP_SCL break under the SIM tray.
Board-defect fix: jumper R6610 to charging port FPC pin 13 (SCL) and R6611 to pin 15 (SDA); each should then read about 0.329 in diode mode.

procedure: Mic1: known-good SE 2020 charge port flex.
Diode-check I2C1_AP_SDA/SCL at the port FPC; jumper around the break if OL.

measurements.point: I2C1_AP_SCL / I2C1_AP_SDA at charge port FPC

card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
card.component: Battery / charge port flex / I2C1 lines

readings.point: I2C1_AP_SCL / I2C1_AP_SDA at charge port FPC
